_note: One friendly, blame-free sentence per rejection reason, shown to the organizer whose listing was rejected. Keys match verdure/validate.py's BLOCKING set exactly. Keep each under 15 words.
missing_title: Add a title so people know what your event is.
missing_start: Add a start date and time.
end_before_start: Check your end time — it's before the start.
already_ended: This event's end time has already passed.
cancelled: This event is marked cancelled, so it's hidden from search.
outside_region: Verdure covers the San José area; this location is outside it.
missing_location_in_person: Add an address so people can find your event.
